verdict.rationale: Veriff documents dedicated test integrations that are created automatically at onboarding, are 'used for development', and do not count towards paid usage. Decisions can be triggered for test sessions, so the integration can be exercised without running live verifications. missing for 10: explicit documentation that test-integration data is isolated from production/live integrations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test integrations are **used for development**. These are automatically created for you as soon as you onboard with Veriff.
Any verification session done in the test integrations **do not count towards paid usage**.
You can trigger decisions for test integration sessions.
